name: Docmost
tagline: Open source collaborative wiki and docs. The Notion + Confluence alternative.
shortDescription: Docmost is a fast, open source collaborative documentation and wiki platform built in 2023. Real-time collaboration, nested pages, permissions, diagrams, draw.io integration, and a Notion-style editor. Self-hostable in Docker with Postgres.
longDescription:
## What it is

Docmost is a wiki and documentation platform for teams. It has a Notion-style block editor, real-time collaboration, nested page hierarchies, granular permissions, image upload, code blocks with syntax highlighting, math (KaTeX), diagrams (Mermaid, draw.io), and a clean API. The codebase is TypeScript + NestJS + React.

## Why we recommend it

It is the best open source Notion/Confluence alternative that launched in the last two years. Notion can't be self-hosted; Confluence is expensive and bloated; BookStack, Outline, and Wiki.js are all older and less polished. Docmost is fast, beautiful, and actively maintained. The Docker setup is one container plus Postgres.

## When to use it

- Internal team documentation replacing Notion or Confluence
- Engineering teams that want a real-time collaborative wiki
- Companies that need to self-host due to compliance
- Anyone who has tried Wiki.js or BookStack and found them too old-feeling
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/docmost/docmost && cd docmost && cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
1. `git clone https://github.com/docmost/docmost && cd docmost`
2. `cp .env.example .env` and fill in `APP_URL`, `APP_SECRET`, and `DATABASE_URL`
3. `docker compose up -d`
4. Open `http://localhost:3000` and create your workspace
5. Invite your team

**Cloud (managed):** Free for 1 user (beta), $8/mo Pro, custom Enterprise.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free, AGPL. Cloud Free: 1 user (beta). Pro: $8/mo. Enterprise: custom.
